data.title: Park Gate 2
data.about:
Park Gate 2 marks the second phase of the highly acclaimed Park Gate development in Dubai Hills Estate. This new release features a refined selection of 4 and 5-bedroom villas with rooftop terraces, designed with natural palettes, elegant contours, and high-end finishes.

Park Gate 2 by Emaar enhances the living experience with an expanded offering of resort-style amenities, including paddle courts, swimming pools, and communal gardens—all created to foster relaxation, connection, and family-focused living. Ideally located within the Green Heart of Dubai, residents enjoy proximity to Dubai Hills Park, the Dubai Hills Mall, and a world-class golf course, offering a perfect balance between nature and urban vibrancy.

location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Nestled within the prestigious Dubai Hills Estate, Parkgate by Emaar unveils itself as a compelling addition to Emaar Properties' latest new launch. This urban haven enjoys a strategically advantageous location, set against the iconic backdrop of the Burj Khalifa and the Dubai skyline. Parkgate ensures a lifestyle that is both convenient and well-connected, with residents seamlessly accessing retail outlets, parks, hospitals, schools, and neighboring residential communities along the bustling Dubai Hills Boulevard
